# hetznerrobot_storagebox_snapshot_plan (Data Source)

Reads the automatic snapshot plan of a Storage Box. Times are in UTC. Only the inclusive **BX10 (100 GB)** Storage Box of a dedicated server is still managed through Robot; every other Storage Box moved to the [Hetzner Console API](https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/hetzner#storage-boxes) (the `hcloud` provider). Every Storage Box write is limited to one request per 5 seconds, which the provider waits out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_storagebox_snapshot_plan" "backup" {
  storagebox_id = 123456
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `storagebox_id` (Number) Storage Box to read.

### Read-Only

- `day_of_month` (Number) Day of the month of the run, null when not set.
- `day_of_week` (Number) Weekday of the run (1 = Monday), null when not set.
- `hour` (Number) Hour of the run, null when disabled.
- `max_snapshots` (Number) Maximum number of automatic snapshots kept.
- `minute` (Number) Minute of the run, null when disabled.
- `month` (Number) Month of the run, null when not set.
- `status` (String) `enabled` or `disabled`.
